page_title: LEN 1-0 ANG | Lens v Angers 26/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Lens take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+6' Anass Zaroury (Lens) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The linesman makes the right call and Lens will have a corner.
90+4' 64:36 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
90+2' Substitution. Goduine Koyalipou is replaced by Anass Zaroury (Lens).
90+1' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Himad Abdelli (Angers) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
87' Angers enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
85' The referee blows his whistle as Jonathan Gradit (Lens) was too aggressive in his challenge.
82' Will Still has decided to substitute Przemyslaw Frankowski and he is replaced by Ruben Aguilar (Lens).
81' A substitution has been made. M'Bala Nzola goes off and Wesley Said (Lens) comes on.
80' Facundo Medina (Lens) was probably a bit loose with his words to Abdelatif Kherradji, who decides to show him a yellow.
79' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.
79' The ball is out of play and Angers manage to earn a corner. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
78' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
76' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
75' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
73' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
71' A dangerous looking corner kick from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is cleared to safety by the defence.
70' Himad Abdelli (Angers) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
69' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Yahia Fofana.
67' Will Still prepares a substitution. Angelo Fulgini is replaced by Andy Diouf (Lens).
66' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. M'Bala Nzola (Lens) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
64' Flag goes up against Esteban Lepaul (Angers) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Bamba Dieng (Angers) is replacing Farid El Melali.
63' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to make a change. Zinedine Ferhat (Angers) replaces Jim Allevinah.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacques Ekomie (Angers) is coming onto the pitch as Florent Hanin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
62' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
60' Deiver Machado (Lens) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

59' Yahia Fofana pulls off a great save to deny M'Bala Nzola (Lens) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!

59' Farid El Melali (Angers) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
57' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

57' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Yahia Fofana shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Now Lens have a corner.
55' The game is interrupted now, Farid El Melali (Angers) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle. Jonathan Gradit (Lens) commits a foul after dangerous play.
53' A cross from Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
52' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Yahia Fofana.
49' 1 - 0 Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
48' The main referee, Abdelatif Kherradji, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Yahia Fofana (Angers) is given a yellow card for dissent.
46' That's the end of the game for Florian Sotoca, who is replaced by Deiver Machado (Lens).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
45+5' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) sends it out of play.
45+2' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

45+2' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Angers will take a corner.
45+1' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
44' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Angelo Fulgini (Lens) but poses no threat.
42' Looks like Jordan Lefort (Angers) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
42' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) is penalised for a foul. Abdelatif Kherradji had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) serves up a nice cross, but Yahia Fofana punches the ball away.
39' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) tries his luck from the edge of the box, but it's one to forget and goes well wide of the left post.
38' Florian Sotoca (Lens) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
36' Himad Abdelli (Angers) brings his opponent down. Abdelatif Kherradji has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Farid El Melali (Angers) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
35' A pass into the penalty area from Jim Allevinah (Angers) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Angers.
34' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Abdelatif Kherradji interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
33' Florian Sotoca (Lens) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
31' Jim Allevinah (Angers) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
27' Facundo Medina (Lens) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
26' Alexandre Dujeux is forced to make a change. Jean-Eudes Aholou is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Yassine Belkhdim (Angers).
26' The ball spins to M'Bala Nzola (Lens) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
24' Abdelatif Kherradji blows his whistle after Facundo Medina (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
23' Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Florian Sotoca (Lens) sends a cross into the box, but Yahia Fofana comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends a cross in and finds Angelo Fulgini inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.
17' Angers fail to score from a corner as Mathew Ryan (Lens) leaps to collect the ball.

16' Jim Allevinah (Angers) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Angers.
15' That was close. Angelo Fulgini (Lens) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lens.
14' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Problems for Alexandre Dujeux as Carlens Arcus is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Lilian Rao-Lisoa (Angers) replaces him.
12' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) is desperate to score a goal, but he misses the target after striking the ball well wide of the left post.
11' Abdelatif Kherradji couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jean-Eudes Aholou (Angers) and blew his whistle.
10' Carlens Arcus (Angers) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' Carlens Arcus (Angers) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
8' Carlens Arcus (Angers) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
7' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
6' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Facundo Medina (Lens), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
4' Abdelatif Kherradji blows for a foul after Malang Sarr (Lens) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
3' Lens are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The first half has started.
Abdelatif Kherradji will referee today's match.
